title: Norwegian Butter Sauce (Sandefjordsmor)
description: Chef John's amazingly simple Norwegian butter sauce is wonderful on all types of fish, but also works beautifully on shrimp and lobster.
ingredients: 5 tablespoons cold, unsalted butter, cut into cubes

steps.text: Place lemon juice in saucepan over medium heat; simmer until lemon juice reduces to less than a tablespoon and almost disappears, 4 or 5 minutes, being careful not to let it burn. Quickly add cream; whisk to combine. Continue to cook until cream reduces and is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, 5 or 6 minutes. Reduce heat to low.

Whisk in 2 or 3 pieces of cold butter, stirring until butter melts before adding more. Add 2 or 3 more butter cubes. (If cream mixture cools too quickly, the sauce may break.) Continue adding butter a few pieces at a time until all butter is emulsified into the cream, 8 to 10 minutes. Add salt, cayenne pepper, and 2 generous tablespoons chopped parsley. Whisk until well blended. Keep sauce warm until ready to use.

video.description: You’ll love how very easy it is to transform four simple ingredients into something very special to elevate your meals! Begin with bright citrusy flavors by reducing lemon juice in a hot pan for a couple of minutes, then add cold cream and reduce until thick. Next, whisk in a high quality unsalted and grass-fed butter a few pieces at a time, until sauce is luxuriously rich. Add salt and cayenne and stir in freshly chopped parsley—or cilantro, dill or tarragon, if you like. Keep warm until you’re ready to serve over fish, meat or vegetables.
